title: Generic residue-field spectrum as a limit of affine neighbourhoods
statement: Let $S$ be a reduced scheme, and $\eta$ a generic point of one of its irreducible components [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction] [def-weil-irreducible-components] [def-sc-generic-point]. Let $N$ be the preorder of affine open neighbourhoods of $\eta$, ordered by inclusion, and let $D:N\to\mathrm{Sch}$ send each open to its open subscheme and each inclusion to the canonical inclusion morphism. The category $N$ is cofiltered. There exist a cone $c$ on $D$, an isomorphism $e:c.\mathrm{pt}\simeq\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(\eta)$, and a proof that $c$ is limiting, such that for every $U\in N$ the composite of the cone leg $c.\mathrm{pt}\to U$ with $U\hookrightarrow S$ is $e$ followed by the canonical residue-field point $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(\eta)\to S$. No integral or Noetherian hypothesis on $S$ is required.

proof.text: The affine neighbourhoods of eta are nonempty and every pair admits a common smaller affine neighbourhood, by the affine-open basis. Thus their inclusion preorder is cofiltered.
The stalk at eta is a field: on an affine neighbourhood eta corresponds to a minimal prime of a reduced ring. The residue map is therefore injective as well as surjective, hence an isomorphism.

Use the existing stalk-spectrum affine-neighbourhood limit. For any cone whose vertex is isomorphic to Spec kappa(eta) and whose legs compose to the canonical residue-field point, cancellation of the open inclusions gives an isomorphism of that cone with the stalk limit. Transport the universal property across this cone isomorphism.

Construct the requested cone explicitly: its vertex is Spec kappa(eta), and its leg at U is Spec of the residue map followed by the canonical map from the stalk spectrum to U. The legs are natural because their composites with open inclusions agree. Apply the preceding comparison with the identity vertex isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem generic_residue_field_affine_limit
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsReduced S] (η : S)
    (hη : ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents S, IsGenericPoint η Z) :
    let N := {U : S.Opens // IsAffineOpen U ∧ η ∈ U}
    let D : N ⥤ Scheme.{u} :=
      (show Monotone (fun U : N ↦ U.1) from fun _ _ h ↦ h).functor ⋙
        S.restrictFunctor ⋙ Over.forget S
    IsCofiltered N ∧
      ∃ (c : Cone D) (e : c.pt ≅ Spec (S.residueField η)),
        (∀ U : N, c.π.app U ≫ U.1.ι = e.hom ≫ S.fromSpecResidueField η) ∧
          Nonempty (IsLimit c)
